template_lines.label: Required documents present
template_lines.why: A dispute without its required documents is denied.
template_lines.fix: Attach the missing document.

template_lines.label: PO number matches
template_lines.why: Every document must point to the PO being disputed.
template_lines.fix: Get a corrected copy showing the right PO number.

template_lines.label: Ship-to matches
template_lines.why: The delivery address must match the PO's ship-to location.
template_lines.fix: Confirm the delivery location with the carrier and get a corrected copy.

template_lines.label: Stamp or signature present
template_lines.why: Walmart treats a POD without a DC stamp or store signature (or a BOL without a carrier signature) as invalid for shortages.
template_lines.fix: Request the stamped or signed copy from the carrier using the PRO number.

template_lines.label: Amounts reconcile exactly
template_lines.why: A dispute amount that doesn't match its backup is rejected even when the claim is valid.
template_lines.fix: Set the dispute amount to the documented shortage, to the cent.

template_lines.label: Proof type fits prepaid or collect
template_lines.why: Prepaid shipments need a POD; collect shipments need a carrier-signed BOL.
template_lines.fix: Attach the proof type that matches the shipment terms.

template_lines.label: Deduction settled
template_lines.why: Disputing before a deduction settles can produce approvals that are later reversed.
template_lines.fix: Wait until the deduction shows as posted, then submit.

template_lines.label: Prior denial addressed
template_lines.why: A re-dispute must fix what the last denial said was wrong.
template_lines.fix: Add the evidence the previous denial asked for.

template_lines.label: Ship-to matches
template_lines.why: The delivery must be to the fulfillment center on the PO.
template_lines.fix: Confirm the delivery FC with the carrier.

template_lines.label: Delivery confirmed by carrier
template_lines.why: Amazon needs proof the shipment reached the fulfillment center.
template_lines.fix: Get the carrier's delivery confirmation with tracking.

template_lines.label: Amounts reconcile exactly
template_lines.why: A dispute amount that doesn't match its backup is rejected.
template_lines.fix: Set the dispute amount to the documented shortage, to the cent.

template_lines.label: Related claims grouped
template_lines.why: Claims for the same PO should be disputed together.
template_lines.fix: Group this claim with the other claims on the same PO.

template_lines.label: Dispute summary written
template_lines.why: Amazon asks for a written explanation of why the claim is wrong.
template_lines.fix: Write or accept the AI-drafted summary.

template_lines.label: Prior denial addressed
template_lines.why: A re-dispute must fix what the last denial said was wrong.
template_lines.fix: Add the evidence the previous denial asked for.

template_lines.label: Required documents present
template_lines.why: Pricing disputes need the invoice, the claim and the PO.
template_lines.fix: Download the claim from APDP/APIS and attach it.

template_lines.label: PO number matches
template_lines.why: The claim and invoice must reference the PO being disputed.
template_lines.fix: Check the claim's PO reference; correct the dispute if it was filed against the wrong PO.

template_lines.label: Item number matches PO
template_lines.why: An item mismatch suggests a substitution, which is a different code.
template_lines.fix: Confirm the item shipped; if substituted, this may be Code 13, not 11.

template_lines.label: Invoice price matches PO price
template_lines.why: If you invoiced above the PO price, Walmart's deduction is probably valid.
template_lines.fix: Review with sales. If the PO price was right, accept and write off; fix the price file.

template_lines.label: Amounts reconcile exactly
template_lines.why: A dispute amount that doesn't match its backup is rejected.
template_lines.fix: Set the dispute amount to the documented difference.

template_lines.label: Deduction settled
template_lines.why: Disputing before a deduction settles can produce reversed approvals.
template_lines.fix: Wait until the deduction shows as posted.

template_lines.label: Dispute summary written
template_lines.why: An explanation helps the reviewer see the price agreement.
template_lines.fix: Write or accept the AI-drafted summary.

template_lines.label: Prior denial addressed
template_lines.why: A re-dispute must fix what the last denial said was wrong.
template_lines.fix: Add the evidence the previous denial asked for.

template_lines.label: Required documents present
template_lines.why: Amazon needs the ASN screenshot or EDI 856 file.
template_lines.fix: Export the EDI 856 (text or XML) or screenshot it in Vendor Central.

template_lines.label: PO number matches
template_lines.why: The ASN must reference the PO on the chargeback.
template_lines.fix: Attach the ASN for the correct PO.

template_lines.label: Carton IDs present (SSCC or AMZNCC)
template_lines.why: Amazon checks that the ASN carried carton-level barcode data.
template_lines.fix: Show where the ASN contained the SSCC or AMZNCC values.

template_lines.label: ASN sent before receipt
template_lines.why: The ASN must have been sent before Amazon received the shipment.
template_lines.fix: If it was sent late, the chargeback is probably valid; accept it and fix the ASN timing.

template_lines.label: Amounts reconcile exactly
template_lines.why: The disputed amount must equal the chargeback amount.
template_lines.fix: Set the dispute amount to the chargeback amount.

template_lines.label: Related chargebacks grouped
template_lines.why: Chargebacks for the same ASIN or PO can be disputed together.
template_lines.fix: Select the related chargebacks in the same dispute.

template_lines.label: Dispute summary written
template_lines.why: Amazon asks for a written explanation in the dispute summary.
template_lines.fix: Write or accept the AI-drafted summary.

template_lines.label: Prior denial addressed
template_lines.why: Amazon allows only two disputes; the second must add new evidence.
template_lines.fix: Add the evidence the previous denial asked for.

template_lines.label: Required documents present
template_lines.why: Amazon needs photos of the carton contents.
template_lines.fix: Photograph an opened carton from the same shipment.

template_lines.label: Carton visibly opened
template_lines.why: Amazon asks for a face-open carton; a sealed box shows nothing.
template_lines.fix: Retake the photo with the carton opened.

template_lines.label: Barcodes legible, match the ASIN
template_lines.why: Barcodes must be readable to prove the labeling was right.
template_lines.fix: Retake the photo closer, with the barcode in focus.

template_lines.label: Inner packs and units visible
template_lines.why: Amazon asks for images showing inner packs and individual sellable units.
template_lines.fix: Retake the photo showing inner packs and units.

template_lines.fix: Set the dispute amount to the chargeback amount.

template_lines.fix: Select the related chargebacks in the same dispute.

template_lines.fix: Write or accept the AI-drafted summary.
